shortDescription: Malaysia's industrial production in July rose 4.7% from a year earlier, below expectations, government data showed on Wednesday.July's factory output had been forecast to expand 5.7%, according to 12 economists surveyed in a Reuters poll.

children: Malaysia's industrial production in July rose 4.7% from a year earlier, below expectations, government data showed on Wednesday.
July's factory output had been forecast to expand 5.7%, according to 12 economists surveyed in a Reuters poll.
